decisions.reason: Explains entry 200 followed by missing sibling chunk 404s because relative imports resolve under the chunk URL, and recommends an inlined single-file bundle or complete artifact set.
Attributes the 403 to uppercase LIB_DIR versus lowercase realpath under a case-sensitive startsWith check, and explains Linux and the control Windows machine outcomes without overgeneralizing.
Proposes path.relative containment with platform semantics, keeps realpath for symlink escape protection, rejects traversal/outside paths, and preserves JavaScript MIME type.
Explains modal and pane handlers act on the same Ctrl+wheel event and gives modal ownership with preventDefault and stopPropagation, plus host-side deferral for capture-phase cases.
Provides meaningful packaging, route, Windows containment, and modal ownership tests, but does not explicitly test that import failure preserves the code-block fallback.
